findings.reason: Narrow window between syncTools(existing, surface, owner) and the transport's async handler lookup: if the context that served the re-sync is disposed immediately (e.g. PATCH /config invalidation with no agent turn; hasInFlightTurn ignores in-flight MCP requests), releaseMcpSessionSurfaces empties the session and tools/call answers NOT_FOUND with the false hint 'the plugin pool changed'. Before this diff the call dispatched into the disposed context — not a new failure mode, only a misleading one. Consider re-syncing from the live context or a retryable 'context rebuilt, retry' error when byName is empty due to a release.
